Maya (PM): Quick sync — finalizing acceptance gates for the chat+embeddings+rerank patch we'll hand off to eng next week. Need sign-off on scope and edge-case list. Specifically: latency SLOs, quality thresholds for rerank, and rollout plan.
Sam (Eng): Can you confirm the latency targets we want to gate on? p95 / p99 for short chat prompts?
Maya (PM): Target: p95 < 120ms, p99 < 300ms for <256 token requests on Dedicated. Hosted can be looser for initial beta: p95 < 240ms. If infra can't hit that we'll set canary with reduced concurrency.
Liam (ML Eng): For rerank, propose NDCG@10 >= 0.77 on our customer benchmark (family of query sets). Also require embeddings cosine stability: mean delta < 0.015 after quantization. If either fails -> block.
Nina (Product Ops): Rollout plan: canary 5% traffic for 48h, monitor token-cost delta, P95 latency, and quality regression (NDCG). If regressions spike -> automatic rollback. Notes: need runbook for false positives.
Ivy (SRE): Add infra acceptance tests: end-to-end smoke harness that exercises streaming + function-calling path; and load test with synthetic mix (50% chat, 30% embeddings, 20% rerank). Failure modes: OOM on KV cache, degraded throughput.
Sam (Eng): Implementation question — do we require deterministic reranker output ordering for tie scores? Some downstream uses rely on stable ordering.
Liam (ML Eng): Yes, stable tie-breaker rule required. Spec: deterministic fallback to document id when scores equal. Add to spec example:
```
{
  "id": "doc-123",
  "score": 0.8421,
  "tie_breaker": "doc-123"
}
```
Maya (PM): Acceptance checklist (engineers, copy to PRD):
- API contract validated (response schema + error codes)
- Latency SLOs met under target load
- NDCG & embedding stability thresholds passed
- Canary rollout + monitoring dashboards live
- Rollback and mitigation playbook documented
Sam (Eng): I'll add unit tests for schema + a smoke script. @Ivy can you add load template to perf infra?
Ivy (SRE): Yep, will add template. Will also wire alert: "rerank-quality-regression" if NDCG drops >0.03 vs baseline during canary.
Nina (Product Ops): Who owns the customer communication? I can draft the launch note and expected impact statement.
Maya (PM): Nina, please draft. Liam, Sam, Ivy — target for code freeze Thursday EOD so we can run canary Fri -> Mon. Any blockers?
Sam (Eng): No blockers on eng side, but need final acceptance on schema from integrations team.
Liam (ML Eng): I'll run the quantization checks tonight and post results.
deploy-bot: deployment created: canary-2026-03-21-01 — monitoring hooks attached :rocket:
Maya (PM): Thanks all — if you hit any edge-case not in the PRD tag it in the thread and we'll triage. :thumbsup:
